_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: BOOSTED. Second defect: 'put a steam counter on A HYPER DRIVER YOU CONTROL' had target 'self', so the counter went on Crankshaft -- which is in the BANISHED zone at that moment, having just been banished from boosting. The CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE gate it carried asked the right question and then did nothing with the answer; the target search now IS the question.
